verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so versioning and governing automations is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no native automation feature with its own versioning, review or rollback. CI runs externally, with Buildkite builds and GitHub Actions results only surfaced as checks. Webhooks and rulesets are adjacent features with no documented history or rollback. Keeping external pipeline files in a Git repo would be a user-side workaround, not the product's own capability.
